articles.text: Bob: ¿Qué les pasó? ¿Por qué llegaron tan tarde?
Bob: What happened to you? Why did you arrive so late?
José: Juan no estaba listo cuando pasé por él.
José: Juan wasn't ready when I came by for him.
Juan: Es que yo no sabía que Ud. nos esperaba a las diez, Bob.
Juan: It's that I didn't know you were expecting us at ten, Bob.
Bob: Está bien, no se preocupen. ¿No vino Carmen?
Bob: It's all right, don't worry. Didn't Carmen come?
José: No, me parece que tenía que ir de compras con su señora.
José: No, I think she had to go shopping with your wife.
Bob: You're right. Now I remember.
